Name: Pipeworks Ninja vs. Unicorn
Description: Ninja vs. Unicorn celebrates the epic battle between two of the biggest hop-heads of lore. Brewed with over five pounds of hops per barrel, this unfiltered double IPA is sure to please the most discerning hop lover.

Name: Pipeworks Lizard King
Description: This American Pale Ale is fresh as they come. Brewed with Mosaic and Amarillo hops, Lizard King will be the perfect way to start (or end) your day.

Name: Pipeworks Lizard King Pale Ale ½ Barrel
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED.  NOTE: An additional deposit charge of $50 is included in the price of this keg.

Name: Evil Twin Even More Jesus
Description: Thick fudge-like body, pitch black color, amazingly overwhelming aromas of chocolate, coffee, dark fruits and muscovado sugar.

Name: Evil Twin Hipster Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This cutting-edge, 'hip without border' pale ale is a homage to you – the global hipster. Cheers!

Name: Mikkeller Blå Spøgelse
Description: Blå Spøgelse, paving the way with its blueberry and oak barrel action, will knock you right off your feet.

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Breakfast
Description: An oatmeal stout with 25.0% oat-based ingredients and a nice touch of gourmet coffee. Good hints of coffee and smoke as well as dark chocolate and roasted malts.

Name: Jack’s Abby House Lager
Description: What the Helles is a Landbier? Ours is sweet and golden with a full malty body, inspired by the country lagers of Bavaria.

Name: Jack’s Abby Post Shift Pilsner
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Biscuit, Bright, Crisp, Dry, Grainy, Light, Minerality
Description: There will be no working during drinking hours! Brewed with Bavarian malt and hops, this everyday Pilsner is bright, crisp and refreshing.

Name: Dogfish Head Seaquench Ale
Description: SeaQuench Ale is a session sour mash-up of a crisp Kolsch, a salty Gose, and a tart Berliner Weiss brewed with black limes, sour lime juice and sea salt.

Name: Dogfish Head 90 Minute IPA
Description: With rich pine and fruity citrus hop aromas and a strong malt backbone, Dogfish Head 90 Minute IPA created pungent, unapologetic flavor.

Name: Dogfish Head 120 Minute IPA
Description: Clocking in at 15-20% ABV, 120 Minute IPA is continuously hopped with a copious amount of high-alpha American hops. Unfiltered and abundantly hoppy, it's the Holy Grail for hopheads!

Name: Avery Brewing White Rascal
Description: An authentic Belgian-style white ale, White Rascal is unfiltered and cleverly spiced with coriander and Curaçao orange peel.

Name: Avery El Gose
Description: A timeless, traditional tart gose with its zesty and salty disposition brightened by a tangy citrus twist.

Name: Lamplighter Rabbit Rabbit Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A dangerously drinkable New England-style double IPA brewed with Citra, Amarillo, and Idaho 7. This beer is a veritable juice bomb. Tasting notes: Tropical, Hop Candy, Ripe Mango

Name: Lamplighter Werewolves Of Cambridge Porter
Description: Our house porter brewed with a variety of black, crystal, and English malts. With a smooth, roasty body and a ton of toffee and chocolate goodness.

Name: Finback Zero Point Gose
Description: Super fun 6% coconut gose. Tart, mellow coconut and sea salt.

Name: Pipeworks Pineapple Bling Belgian Golden Ale
Jack’s Abby Framinghammer Baltic Porter
Tasting Notes: Bold, Fig, Leather, Malty, Oak, Smooth, Velvety
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: This unusual lager style has many similarities to Imperial Stouts. A lengthy conditioning period creates a silky smooth chocolaty mouth feel enhanced by the use of oats and brown sugar.
